4-1B triggering has a unifying effect of immune modulation, which can be beneficial or deleterious depending on the type of protective immune response required to clear the infection.

4-1Bb triggering has a beneficial therapeutic effect on virus infection if the protective immunity generated was beneficially altered, but not if it was not altered or if it was altered to be deleterious.
